lines.speaker: captain_maer
lines.text: You've stolen from two of our camp supplies.

lines.speaker: captain_maer
lines.text: I don't care what you call it. Not again.

lines.speaker: tessaly_veil
lines.text: You were an officer. You know how to give orders people actually follow.

lines.speaker: captain_maer
lines.text: I learned to give orders people can live with. Different thing.

lines.speaker: captain_maer
lines.text: I need to know I can trust you when it matters.

lines.speaker: tessaly_veil
lines.text: When it matters, I'm exactly where I need to be. That's the only guarantee I give.

lines.speaker: tessaly_veil
lines.text: You didn't turn me in at Stoneward. You could have.

lines.speaker: captain_maer
lines.text: We needed you. Doesn't mean I forgot.

lines.speaker: captain_maer
lines.text: What do you actually want out of all this?

lines.speaker: tessaly_veil
lines.text: To reach the end with more options than I started with.

lines.speaker: captain_maer
lines.text: That's the most honest thing you've said to me.
